key_facts: OpenAI’s 2026 pricing lists $15 per 1 million input tokens for GPT‑4o, making large‑scale inference a significant budget item.
A 2025 survey of 300 enterprise developers showed 68% preferred LLMs for natural language tasks due to higher contextual understanding than rule‑based NLP pipelines.

Traditional AI alternatives such as retrieval‑augmented generation or symbolic AI can reduce compute costs by up to 40% while delivering comparable accuracy on structured query tasks (TechRadar 2025).
Deploying LLMs on‑premise requires GPU clusters with at least 8 × A100 GPUs to achieve latency under 200 ms, whereas lightweight models run on standard CPUs with <50 ms latency (MLPerf 2025).
Maintenance overhead for LLM apps includes continuous prompt engineering and model updates, which industry reports estimate adds 15–20% more engineering hours compared to static rule‑based systems.
